a.lede: Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO, with the option to go much higher. Google is a close second with holdings of nearly 14%.
a.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO

b.lede: Anthropic faces enormous compute commitments as it goes public, but its biggest infrastructure partners, including Amazon and Google, could continue profiting from AI even if Anthropic loses its lead.
b.title: Anthropic’s IPO puts AI’s circular financing boom to the test
